findings.title: findMany method removed from public API; callers will break at runtime
findings.body: The `findMany(findManyArgs: Prisma.BookingTimeStatusDenormalizedFindManyArgs)` method has been removed and replaced with `getBaseConditions(): Promise<Prisma.Sql>`. This is a breaking change to the public API of `InsightsBookingService`. Any callers in the codebase (e.g., routing layers, controller handlers, or other services) that invoke `service.findMany(...)` will fail at runtime with `TypeError: service.findMany is not a function`. The PR description frames this as a test-update PR, but the diff also rewrites the service. No callers of `findMany` are updated in this diff; if any exist they must be migrated to obtain the SQL fragment via `getBaseConditions()` and execute it with `prisma.$queryRaw` (or similar).

findings.title: Caching describe block removed; coverage lost for cachedAuthConditions and cachedFilterConditions
findings.body: The "Caching" describe block (which previously contained `should cache authorization conditions` and `should cache filter conditions` tests that asserted the second call returned an object structurally equal to the first) has been deleted from the test file. This drops all coverage for the `cachedAuthConditions` and `cachedFilterConditions` memoization in `getAuthorizationConditions` and `getFilterConditions`. If caching regresses (e.g., conditions are rebuilt on every call, causing an extra DB roundtrip per request, or a future change forgets to invalidate the cache when options/filters change), no test will detect it. The deleted block was located where the new `describe("getBaseConditions", ...)` (line 437) now begins.

findings.title: Integration test relies on BookingTimeStatusDenormalized being populated synchronously by triggers
findings.body: The "should combine authorization and filter conditions" test creates a booking directly via `prisma.booking.create(...)` and then queries `BookingTimeStatusDenormalized` with `prisma.$queryRaw`, expecting exactly `[{ id: userBooking.id }]`. `BookingTimeStatusDenormalized` is a denormalized table that is normally populated by PostgreSQL triggers on Booking INSERTs/UPDATEs. If those triggers are absent in the test environment, are disabled, or run asynchronously, the booking will not appear in the denormalized table and the assertion will fail with an empty array. The PR author explicitly acknowledges they could not run the integration tests due to test-runner configuration issues and asks the reviewer to verify execution manually; this specific test is the most fragile in the suite and the most likely to fail.
